title: My Dog Max
text:
I have a dog. His name is Max. He is brown and very friendly. Every morning, I give him water and food.

Max likes to play with a red ball. We play in the park after school. He runs fast and he jumps high. At night, he sleeps in his bed next to my room.

questions.text: What is the name of the dog?
What does Max like to play with?
Why is the writer probably a responsible pet owner?
options: Because they give Max food and water every day
Because they never play with Max
Because Max sleeps outside in the rain
Because they only see Max at night

questions.text: How does the writer probably feel about Max?
options: The writer is afraid of Max
The writer does not know Max
The writer wants to sell Max

vocabulary.definition: kind and pleasant to be with
a round object that children and animals play with
moves up quickly from the ground using the legs

paragraph_translations: Tengo un perro. Se llama Max. Es marrón y muy amigable. Cada mañana, le doy agua y comida.
Max le gusta jugar con una pelota roja. Jugamos en el parque después de la escuela. Corre rápido y salta alto. Por la noche, duerme en su cama al lado de mi habitación.
